slides.title: AI websites all look the same.
slides.sub: 5 Claude skills that fix it, with the exact install commands.

slides.title: The model picks the average.
slides.body: Without direction, Claude samples from the **high-probability center** of its training data. Anthropic says the result is almost always:
slides.quote: Inter fonts, purple gradients on white backgrounds, and minimal animations.
slides.quote_src: Anthropic, “Improving frontend design through Skills”, 12 Nov 2025
slides.close: A skill gives Claude a point of view **before** it writes code.

slides.name: frontend-design
slides.what: Makes Claude choose a palette, type and layout first, then check that plan against **generic AI defaults** and revise it before building.
slides.use: Every project. Install this one first.

slides.name: Impeccable
slides.what: One skill, **24 commands**: audit, critique, polish, bolder, quieter. Plus **59 detector rules** that catch AI-generated design tells, with no API key.
slides.use: The last pass before a client sees it.
slides.install_label: Install, then run inside Claude Code

slides.name: UI/UX Pro Max
slides.maker: Open source, by Next Level Builder
slides.what: Builds a design system from your brief: style, colours, font pairing and page pattern. **79 searchable UI styles**, **192 reasoning rules**.
slides.use: Starting a new site from a blank page.

slides.name: GSAP skills
slides.what: Teaches Claude correct GSAP: timelines, **ScrollTrigger pin and scrub**, React cleanup and performance. Every GSAP plugin is now free.

slides.name: webapp-testing
slides.what: Claude opens your site in a real browser with Playwright, **takes screenshots** and reads the console logs. No more designing blind.
slides.use: Checking the build on phone and desktop.
slides.install_label: Install in Claude Code (Anthropic's example pack)

slides.title: Read a skill first.
slides.body: A skill is instructions plus scripts that run with **your permissions**. Open SKILL.md and skim the scripts before you install.
slides.note: All five are public repos, updated in 2026.
slides.cta: Save this for your next build.
